Projects.Name: AWS.Bedrock.MEAI
ChangelogMessages: Fixed BedrockChatClient silently dropping tool-call argument values whose type is not bool/int/long/float/double/string/JsonElement (e.g. null, decimal, Guid, DateTime, nested dictionaries, collections, POCOs). Such values are now serialized into ToolUseBlock.Input, matching the tool-result path (null becomes a JSON null).
